plan.title: Make eltmon/okf the canonical OKF skill; Overdeck vendors a pinned tag
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: PAN-A is a pre-filed, operator-approved unit in the PAN-A → OKF-1 → … → PAN-B → PAN-C chain (eltmon/okf PRD §6), and OKF-1 is blocked on it. The file count includes four eltmon/okf files in a sibling repo and small single-purpose tests. The subsystem count is inflated because single-file paths (CLAUDE.md, .husky/pre-push, configuration/knowledge.mdx, scripts/vendor-okf-skill.sh) each count as their own subsystem. The okf release, the vendor script and the pin workflow are one chain (tag → vendor → pin), and the sync convergence and doctor warning only make sense once a pinned version file exists.

narratives.Problem: sync-sources/skills/okf/ was canonical and subtree-mirrored to eltmon/okf, so the public repo could not take fixes, and it has no LICENSE. Since 2026-09-29 eltmon/okf carries the v0.2 PRD and has diverged; the mirror and its drift gate were retired in abaeeab9647. Installed skill copies in ~/.claude/skills/okf and ~/.agents/skills/okf still hold a 2026-09-01 variant because pan sync treats files whose hash differs from its manifest as user edits and skips them.
narratives.Proposal: Make eltmon/okf canonical: add LICENSE, NOTICE and a selftest CI workflow there, rewrite its README install section, tag v0.1.0 on that release commit and merge it into okf main. In Overdeck, add scripts/vendor-okf-skill.sh (vendor and --check modes, one root-anchored exclude list, .okf-skill-version pin file), vendor v0.1.0, and add okf-vendor-pin.yml running the check. Make pan sync converge real-directory installed copies of vendored skills (okf) and report replaced files, add a pan doctor OKF Skill Version skew warning, and document where the skill lives.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Refreshing per-bundle .okf/scripts in knowledge repos (OKF-4 upgrade-bundle).
- Rewriting existing per-agent CODEX_HOME/skills copies; they refresh from ~/.agents/skills at the next Codex spawn.
- Changing okf skill content (SKILL.md, scripts, references) beyond README's install section and the new LICENSE, NOTICE and ci.yml.
- Any OKF v0.2 work (OKF-1..OKF-9, PAN-B, PAN-C), including pytest in eltmon/okf.
- Deleting __pycache__ from installed copies, or changing pan sync behavior for any non-vendored skill.
- Writing into or re-pointing a symlinked skill root.
- Creating a GitHub Release object for v0.1.0.
- Re-creating okf-mirror-drift.yml or mirror-okf-skill.sh, or any workflow that compares against eltmon/okf main.
- Hand-editing any file under sync-sources/skills/okf.
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap.
- Running a real pan sync from the workspace under a substituted HOME or OVERDECK_HOME.

autoDecisions.summary: Tag v0.1.0 on a release commit branched from fe73d46 that adds LICENSE, NOTICE, ci.yml and the README install rewrite, not on fe73d46 itself.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says tag at fe73d46 but its AC requires LICENSE and NOTICE in the v0.1.0 filtered tree, and fe73d46 has neither. A release commit off fe73d46 keeps every stated intent: no .pan/, skill content unchanged except README, LICENSE/NOTICE present. Merged into okf main with a merge commit so the tag stays reachable.

autoDecisions.summary: Edit the README install section in eltmon/okf before tagging, not in sync-sources/skills/okf/README.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: sync-sources/skills/okf is vendored; any in-place edit fails the pin check. The README reaches Overdeck through the v0.1.0 vendor step.

autoDecisions.summary: Corroborate cross-repo items with empty commits carrying the Item trailer on feature/pan-4408.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan task done only searches this repo for the Item trailer; commits in eltmon/okf never satisfy it.

autoDecisions.summary: The pin workflow calls `scripts/vendor-okf-skill.sh --check` instead of re-implementing the filter.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the same exclude list in both places; one bash array in one script guarantees that.

autoDecisions.summary: Root-anchored rsync excludes, --tarball/--dest flags for offline tests, pin file = tag plus newline.
autoDecisions.rationale: templates/repo/.github and templates/repo/.gitignore are skill content and must survive; tests must not hit the network; the simplest pin format serves both doctor and the check.

autoDecisions.summary: pan sync force-converges only vendored skills (okf) whose installed root is a real directory; symlinked roots keep conflict behavior.
autoDecisions.rationale: The stale 2026-09-01 variant survived because modified files are skipped as user edits. The old README told users to symlink their okf checkout, and sync must never write replacements through into it.
Python writes __pycache__ into installed script dirs at run time; it is not skill content.

autoDecisions.summary: The CI deliberate-edit proof runs on this PR (red commit then revert), not via workflow_dispatch.
autoDecisions.rationale: workflow_dispatch only works for workflows already on the default branch; the Vitest --check case is the mechanical negative proof and the PR-run checkpoint has a recorded fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: The doctor check lives in doctor-okf-skill.ts and is wired by editing the existing doctor.ts line 828 with a dynamic import.
autoDecisions.rationale: doctor.ts is at its 1042-line cap and agents may not raise caps; line 771 already uses the dynamic-import pattern.

autoDecisions.summary: Live host convergence is verified after merge + pan reload + pan sync, not from the workspace.
autoDecisions.rationale: The deployed pan reads sync-sources from the primary checkout, and running pan sync under a substituted HOME/OVERDECK_HOME risks shared state (Herdr unit).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep this as one issue with a sizeJustification instead of splitting into siblings.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-A is a pre-filed unit in the operator-approved PAN-A → OKF-1 chain; OKF-1 is blocked on it.

Add scripts/vendor-okf-skill.sh with vendor and --check modes

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5 and decisions D4-D7. Create executable bash script scripts/vendor-okf-skill.sh: `<tag> [--tarball <file>] [--dest <dir>]` vendors, `--check [--tarball <file>] [--dest <dir>]` compares. Usage errors exit 2 with a `usage:` line. One EXCLUDES array (.github .pan .overdeck tests CHANGELOG.md .gitignore .gitattributes) turned into root-anchored rsync filters `--exclude=/<entry>`. Download from https://github.com/eltmon/okf/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz unless --tarball; extract with --strip-components=1 into a mktemp dir cleaned by `trap 'rm -rf -- "${tmp:?}"' EXIT`. Vendor mode refuses a tarball without LICENSE or NOTICE, then `rsync -a --delete` into dest and writes `<tag>\n` to .okf-skill-version. Check mode reads the tag from the pin file, builds the expected tree the same way, and `diff -r -x __pycache__` against dest, exiting 1 with a `::error::` message on difference. Write tests/unit/scripts/vendor-okf-skill.test.ts with the 8 fixture-tarball cases listed in PRD WI-5; never hit the network.
